name: WWA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The federation's top title. Bedrock held it through the summer of 2001, beating Crimestarter Jim and Xavier Stone together in a three-way at One Night Only, and was still champion on the roster of 23 September 2001.

name: WWA International Championship
epitaph: Rosco Riggins held it through 2001, keeping it in a ladder match at Spring Fling and against Rizer by submission on WWA Live of 21 September 2001, and was still champion on the roster of 23 September 2001.

name: WWA North American Television Championship
epitaph: Defended under hardcore rules. William Karnes kept it against both Untouchables at One Night Only and had lost it by early September 2001; Bill Bartlett, billed its new champion on WWA Live of 21 September 2001, kept it against Jayson Carter that night.

name: WWA Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The Blonde Brigade held it until the Frat beat them at One Night Only in August 2001; Crimestarter Jim and Xavier Stone of the PTA took it from the Frat in a three-way with Mark Haley and the Fallen Angel on WWA Live of 21 September 2001.
